description: Save steps you will run again as a preset, then run it with run_preset. Save one when you have run the same chain twice, or when a batch has to stay consistent (a preset with subjects). Each step is one op from the catalogue with the parameters transform takes for it (the resource imagestep://ops/{op}); the service checks every step before storing anything and refuses a bad one with invalid_param naming steps[i] — including an order that cannot run: an op that answers with JSON (analyze) anywhere but last, or one that reads no image (generate) in a preset of several steps. Steps may mix deterministic ops and AI ops: a preset with an AI step beside other steps runs as one chain job, and run_preset's dry_run prices it step by step. Answers `warnings` when the steps are legal but probably not what you meant. Answers `preset` as slug@version: pass that to run_preset so a later run is this version. A slug already in use is refused; pick another. Free: no credits, no job.

description.description: One sentence on what the preset is for.

idempotency_key.description: Your key for this write. Calling again with the same key and the same arguments returns what the first call answered instead of writing twice; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reuse.

name.description: What a person sees in the console.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; derived from name when omitted. builtin- is reserved.

steps.description: Run in order, one op per step.

model.description: AI steps only: the model. Default: the op's defaultModel.

parameters.description: The op's parameters — the same contract transform takes.

prompt.description: AI steps only. {{subject.<name>}} expands to that subject's descriptor.

subjects.description: Consistency for a recurring character or product. Needs a generate or edit step.

descriptor.description: Colour and material only — the images carry the shape.

name.description: Lowercase handle, unique among the subjects; referenced in a prompt as {{subject.<name>}}.

referenceAssetIds.description: Your own finished assets; they pin the geometry. At most four across all subjects.

name: save_preset

error.description: A refused call (isError): code, message, retryable — whether the same call can succeed — and param, the input to fix.

preset.description: slug@version: what run_preset takes to run exactly this version.

warnings.description: Saved anyway; what the service flagged.

title: Save a preset (a named, versioned list of op steps)
